title: Austin's Gas Rate Debate
summary:
*   A special, unscheduled meeting was convened to urgently discuss Southern Union Gas rates.
*   City officials held extensive discussions with representatives from the Southern Union Gas Company regarding their pricing.
*   The focused deliberation on gas rates lasted over three hours, from 8:00 PM to 11:30 PM.
